access_rights_boundary: public product chooser; generic preference selections only; no personal data, account, purchase, cart addition, catalog navigation, or product link followed; evidence only
accessibility_localization_evidence: level-two Recommendations for you heading, explanatory outcome text, and a named recommended key expose the completed chooser result
consequence_risk: a visitor may not know which authentication key matches the selected device and connection needs
content_object_schema_hypothesis: completed product-recommendation result with rationale, recommended item, and optional next actions
system_status: chooser completed and displayed a tailored YubiKey recommendation
trigger: visitor completes the public chooser using Novice, Desktop or Laptop, USB C, and No selections
user_goal: identify a YubiKey suited to the selected needs
visible_action_recovery: reset the quiz, inspect the recommended key, or check compatibility without any action being followed
